links.outcome: PPV achieved at external hospitals with vs without unlabeled-data calibration shift correction
links.effect: Trained for PPV of 20%, PPV with vs without calibration shift estimation was 18.0% vs 12.9% and 23.1% vs 13.4% at the two external validation cohorts.
links.quote: For instance, when trained to achieve a PPV of 20%, the performance of the sepsis prediction model with and without the calibration shift estimation model was 18.0% vs 12.9% and 23.1% vs 13.4% at the two external validation cohorts, respectively.
